description: The primary interface is a full-screen split — Receive pane on top, Send pane on bottom — with image thumbnails, per-item retention and target controls, and correct empty, loading, and error states; the layout is fully usable from small phone widths through desktop.

requirements.description: The primary interface renders as a full-screen vertical split with a Receive pane occupying the top half and a Send pane occupying the bottom half. The Receive pane displays received items with image thumbnails, retention policy badges, per-item action controls (download, pin, delete, target), and correct empty, loading, and error states. The Send pane provides input for files and text snippets, per-item retention and target controls, and a send action. The layout is fully usable from 320px phone width through desktop viewport widths. All interactive controls are keyboard navigable and have appropriate ARIA attributes and data-testid selectors.
requirements.title: Polished Responsive Split-Screen UI with Receive and Send Panes

validation.notes: Vitest: ReceivePane renders empty state with correct aria-label when items list is empty
Vitest: ReceivePane renders loading skeleton when isLoading=true
Vitest: ReceivePane renders error banner with retry action when error prop is set
Vitest: SendPane renders per-item retention selector and target selector for each staged item
Vitest: image item renders thumbnail img element with non-empty src and descriptive alt text
Vitest: layout component applies correct CSS classes for split-screen at 320px, 768px, and 1440px breakpoints via snapshot test
Integration test: upload a file; assert image thumbnail is visible in Receive pane within 2 seconds
Integration test: empty Receive pane displays correct empty-state illustration and copy
BAS smoke: navigate to main UI; confirm split-screen layout renders on mobile (375px) and desktop (1440px) without horizontal scroll
Accessibility audit: axe-core scan on main view returns zero critical violations
Playbook: tab through all interactive elements in Send and Receive panes; confirm logical focus order

title: Polished Responsive Split-Screen UI
